title: Polar M600 Oreo update
symptom: Installing the stock Oreo update from Polar will break my ROM patches. Patches need to be updated for Oreo.
fix: The wiki page was updated with a new M600 Oreo care package. Tests show it working with G5 and other collectors like miaomiao, and the user confirmed it worked after trying again.
evidence_quote: Page updated with the new M600 Oreo care package. Tests here show it working with G5 and other collectors like miaomiao - Make sure to use the latest xDrip nightly watchface.
